item.title: Insurance Coverage for Individuals with Mental Health Conditions

attempt.title: Insurance Coverage for Individuals with Mental Health Conditions
attempt.what_it_is: Insurance Coverage for Individuals with Mental Health Conditions

sections.label: Mental health insurance coverage concerns
sections.summary: Response covers written Question No 24 and concerns about denial of health insurance coverage due to mental health conditions, within the S+3M safety net and MediShield Life.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: My response will also cover the matters raised in the written Question No 24 by Dr Tan Wu Meng in today's Order Paper.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Members raised concerns about individuals being denied health insurance coverage due to their mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: This is a valid concern and should be considered within the larger context of our S+3M healthcare safety net system.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: All Singaporeans and Permanent Residents are also covered under MediShield Life (MSHL), regardless of pre-existing conditions, including mental health conditions.

sections.label: Insurer underwriting fairness expectations
sections.summary: MOH and MAS expect insurers to deal fairly and not indiscriminately reject applications based solely on declared personal information, including mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: In making underwriting decisions, insurers are fully expected by the Ministry of Health (MOH) and the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) to deal fairly with their customers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: For example, insurers should not indiscriminately reject an application solely on the basis of declared personal information, such as occupation, income, disability or medical condition, including mental health conditions.

sections.label: MAS action and appeal channels
sections.summary: MAS will act against insurers breaching its regulations or guidance, and individuals can appeal underwriting decisions through their insurer or MAS.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: MAS will take action against insurers whose practices are in breach of MAS’ regulations or guidance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Individuals who have concerns over their insurer’s underwriting decision can make an appeal through their insurer’s feedback channel or through MAS.
